findings.description: User input is reflected in the HTTP response without proper output encoding.
findings.remediation: Apply context-aware output encoding and sanitize user input.

findings.description: Environment configuration file is publicly accessible.
findings.remediation: Configure web server to deny access to dotfiles and sensitive directories.

findings.description: The endpoint does not enforce object-level authorization, allowing access to other users' data.
findings.remediation: Implement strict object-level authorization checks validating the requested ID against the authenticated user's session.
